headline: Impacts of Dollar Counterfeiting in Peru
content: Its not any secret that Peru is the first country producer of fake dollars worldwide and there isnt anything to feel proud about. From time to time, police capture counterfeiting gangs and seize stacks of counterfeit bills ready for shipment to the United States or other countries.  These criminal organizations mainly employ young people from high social classes as drug runners, carrying their merchandise abroad.

headline: Child Drives Car Two Kilometers For Hamburgers
content: An eight-year-old boy drove his father’s pickup truck up to a fast-food restaurant to get himself some cheeseburgers. He claimed he learned how to drive after watching YouTube tutorials. headline: Over One Million Venezuelans Seek Temporary Stay Permit in Peru
content: More than a million Venezuelan citizens have arrived in Peru seeking temporary stay permits since July 31st. Despite challenges like exploitation and low wages, many express gratitude towards the hospitality shown by locals.
